title: Other State Department jazz tours and the length of this one
summary: Jack lists tours by Dizzy and Brubeck and says theirs was longest, 120 concerts over 18 weeks, starting in Afghanistan.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How many of these jazz tours have gone out under the State Department? We've all went to different places.

Dizé covered the Middle East. The Middle East which is Iraq and Greece and Turkey and and Israel. And Brubeck he went the other direction. He went from Japan to I guess he went to Thailand and Afghanistan. And we went by the way of New York around from East to West. We went East.
The first stop was in Afghanistan.
And ours was the longest trip. Yeah, it was 120 concerts and it was 18 weeks.
